name: release
description: Purpose agent kiem tra release readiness cho Viezan: smoke, build/test/package, signing/notarization, security, i18n, docs va release notes.

classification.use_for: Use when the user asks to prepare, verify, tag, package or publish a Viezan release.

activation_examples: Kiem tra build package truoc khi publish

relationship_model: release-readiness workflow -> product smoke, package, security, i18n, extension, live-perf and docs gates
gate workflow -> domain skill/rule used for evidence and fixes
rule -> release edits, workflow fixes and docs updates
requirements: Resolve release-readiness and all declared gate workflows before release verdict.
Do not mark a release ready when a required gate is skipped without a blocker reason.
Use security, i18n, extension, live-perf and docs capabilities from this registry for the matching gates.
If package/signing/notarization evidence cannot be gathered, mark the gate Blocked instead of assuming pass.

operating_workflow.action: Identify version, target platforms, changed files, release notes and asset expectations.
Run product smoke, tests/build/package sanity, security/local-first, i18n and docs gates.
Classify blockers: security leak, build failure, broken core flows, missing release assets.
Return readiness verdict with commands, blocking issues and follow-up actions.

completion_rules: Do not publish or mark ready without resolving the primary release workflow.
Security, i18n and docs gates are required for every release pass.
Extension UX and live/performance gates must run or be explicitly marked Not run/Blocked with reason.
Final verification must list release workflows/skills/rules actually used.
